options.name: account
options.description: Account name to use when accessing the LDAP server.

options.name: account_password
options.description: Account password to use when accessing the LDAP server. Required when using I(onthefly_register). When this parameter is set, the module will not be idempotent.

options.name: attr_firstname
options.description: Attribute containing first name. Required when using I(onthefly_register).

options.name: attr_lastname
options.description: Attribute containing last name. Required when using I(onthefly_register).

options.name: attr_login
options.description: Attribute containing login ID. Required when using I(onthefly_register).

options.name: attr_mail
options.description: Attribute containing email address. Required when using I(onthefly_register).

options.name: attr_photo
options.description: Attribute containing user photo

options.name: base_dn
options.description: The base DN to use when searching.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: groups_base
options.description: Base DN where groups reside.

options.name: host
options.description: The hostname of the LDAP server

options.name: ldap_filter
options.description: Filter to apply to LDAP searches

options.name: ldap_group_membership
options.description: Which group membership method to use, not valid for I(server_type=active_directory). Option I(rfc4519) is valid only for I(server_type=posix).

options.name: locations
options.description: List of locations the entity should be assigned to

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the LDAP authentication source

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: onthefly_register
options.description: Whether or not to register users on the fly.

options.name: organizations
options.description: List of organizations the entity should be assigned to

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the LDAP server

options.name: server_type
options.description: Type of the LDAP server

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the entity

options.name: tls
options.description: Whether or not to use TLS when contacting the LDAP server.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: use_netgroups
options.description: Whether to use NIS netgroups instead of posix groups, not valid for I(server_type=active_directory) Deprecated: The I(use_netgroups) parameter is deprecated with Foreman 3.16 in favor of I(ldap_group_membership) and will be removed in a future release.

options.name: usergroup_sync
options.description: Whether or not to sync external user groups on login

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
